method: Held-out trigger eval. A judge sees ONLY the skill's frontmatter `description` (the real selection signal) plus the prompt, and predicts whether design-review should fire. Predictions are scored against the `expected` gold labels below → precision/recall. LLM-judged, so results.json is a snapshot (re-runs may vary slightly).

is this signup form accessible?
can you do a design review of the dashboard component?
check the visual hierarchy on my landing page
audit this interface for UX issues
